lines.text: Wait! Why Strong Stomach Acid Doesn't Melt Your Own Tummy!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why stomach acid doesnt digest stomach!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Your tummy makes strong acid to break down pizza, while special lining.
cells paint a slippery mucus shield and rebuild fast every few days.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Mucus Super Shield!
